To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the GPU memory system is not as simple and straightforward as it is often presented and that the performance is highly sensitive to the data reuse.
the GPU architecture can be viewed as a vector machine with a multithreaded vector processor core and a vector memory system with a vector cache and vector TLB.

(a) modern GPUs are vector machines with multithreaded vector units and vector caches, (b) they can be programmed similarly to vector computers using blocking and (c) their memory system is similar to the one of the CPU, with caches and a TLB.
